Every record is 'verdict: correct' -- this batch found no new extractor bug (the first sample in this project's 9-session sampling history not to). Batch 2 (gold_id 50-99, seed 20260922, built 2026-09-22, disjoint from batch 1): same read-by-hand method. 49/50 records are 'verdict: correct'; one (gold_id 52, row 46605) is 'verdict: known_gap' -- a documented, unfixed extractor limitation (a LexUZ 'paragrafi'->'paragrifi' misspelling isn't recognized as the paragraf unit word) recorded with its true expected output so it scores as an honest recall miss rather than being silently marked correct.
